summary: Researched dropping Connectives.lean (PR #662) in favor of #607's Operators hierarchy. Key finding: the 'unused' premise is false in the working tree -- Connectives typeclasses (HasBot/HasImp/HasBox/PropositionalConnectives/ModalConnectives) are load-bearing across Axioms.lean, ProofSystem.lean, Theorems/Modal/*, and the neg/top defaults used by Bimodal/LTL/Temporal. 'Unused' holds only for PR #662 viewed in isolation against upstream/main. PR #607 is unmerged and NOT a drop-in replacement (no HasBot, no bundles, impl-vs-imp naming, primitive not vs bot, opposite Modal primitives). Recommend BLOCKED for literal deletion; preferred rescope decouples PR #662 branch from the foundations typeclass file.
